title: This AI entrepreneur is developing agents that can plan ahead for the unexpected
summary: Danijar Hafner’s office in San Francisco’s SoMa district sits mostly empty. His brand-new startup is still in stealth mode and doesn’t even have its name on the door. On the day I visited, earlier this year, there’s only one other person there, and little in the way of furniture.
reason: This is a human-interest profile of an entrepreneur and his stealth-mode startup. It reports no new model, paper, financing/M&A/partnership/product launch, policy action, or open-source release, so no active rule covers it.
